How it drives

High speed, acceleration and control favour accurate lines. Its short BOOST tank makes timing more important than holding the button.

Original perk

OVERCHARGE increases CONTROL and ACCELERATION beyond their ordinary limits.

epic Can also be installed on other cars through PERKULATOR.

Try a build

TORQUE can grow the tank while OVERCHARGE is held and strengthen its KICK. Catch first, then spend on a useful exit.

Practice: AIRPORT. Explore TORQUE.

Example SHIFT setup

One legal example moves one point per attribute. Lower TOP SPEED, ACCELERATION, CONTROL; raise DRIFT, BOOST POWER, BOOST TANK. Try the two states on the same section to feel the trade-off.
